name: Mitsu
description: Terminal AI pentest agent with a 165-tool catalog, driving Codex or Claude Code over a local MCP server
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: User agent of Mitsu's web_search MCP tool when it opens a URL (target pages: the system prompt tells the model to open every URL the operator gives this way before curl or wget), and of its search-engine scraping and search API calls (search/engines.py:77,123,293,449)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Mitsu source code

indicators.context: User agent of Mitsu's update check, GET https://pypi.org/pypi/mitsu/json when the operator opens the update panel of a PyPI install (tui/updates.py:16,186). HTTPS: visible only with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Mitsu source code

indicators.context: User agent of the probe Mitsu sends to its own SearXNG container on 127.0.0.1 (GET /search?q=mitsu%20local%20search&format=json). Loopback only and a short string: context
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Mitsu source code

indicators.context: Codex CLI option Mitsu passes on every turn of its Codex provider: codex exec --json ... --config mcp_servers.mitsu.url="http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<token>/mcp" --config mcp_servers.mitsu.enabled=true. Seen in process command lines
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Mitsu source code

indicators.context: Tool-name prefix Mitsu passes to claude -p on every turn of its Claude Code provider (--allowedTools mcp__mitsu__<tool>, with --mcp-config {"mcpServers":{"mitsu":{"type":"http","url":"http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<token>/mcp"}}} and --permission-mode dontAsk). Seen in process command lines and in decrypted Claude Code model
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Mitsu source code
